builder_reading: Section 17 section 2 calls Operationally verified evidence "applicable". Each requirement has a required level; every rung up to that level is mandatory; higher rungs may be left out.
effect_if_wrong: Affects requirement closure evidence: a requirement could be closed on fewer rungs than the auditor intends.

builder_reading: The role names product_owner, spec_approver, authorised_reviewer, closure_authority, authority_owner, materiality_owner, policy_reviewer and finance_reviewer are placeholders.
effect_if_wrong: Affects the mapping to the real platform roles; every check keyed on a role name must be re-mapped.
auditor_note: Auditor: affects the mapping to real platform roles.

builder_reading: The first policy is compared with a fail-safe baseline (no rules), so it counts as a loosening that needs two humans including the owner.
effect_if_wrong: The first policy could be activated with fewer approvers than intended.

builder_reading: The engine adds this reason code; the CR-02 model has no such reason.
effect_if_wrong: A downstream consumer may not expect the code.

builder_reading: Evidence for run-type statuses carries an artefact hash and names its tests; the exact form is the builder.
effect_if_wrong: The form of integrity metadata may not match what the auditor wants.

builder_reading: A row has an intrinsic outcome at intake (accepted, accepted_with_warnings, pending_reconciliation, quarantined, rejected) and an effective outcome after reconciliation. Rejected rows are never stored as records; they are kept as reject evidence with the reason.
effect_if_wrong: Reviewers may expect a different set of states or a different place for rejected rows.

topic: Exact duplicate delivery versus duplicate candidate
builder_reading: Two invoices are an exact duplicate delivery only if supplier and supplier invoice number match AND every business field is equal. Anything less (same details, different or missing invoice number) is a DUPLICATE_CANDIDATE held for a person. The lowest key is treated as the original so the result does not depend on arrival order.
effect_if_wrong: Too strict leaves real duplicates for people; too loose counts a repeat once when it was two events.

builder_reading: A second delivery with the same key and different content at the same or unknown revision is a conflict: the record becomes a quarantined marker that keeps every version, sorted so arrival order does not matter. A higher declared revision supersedes an open conflict. A lower revision is stale evidence, not an update.
effect_if_wrong: Different treatment of corrections could overwrite financial data or hide a conflict.

builder_reading: Fail-safe: any optional value that is missing and not declared tolerable blocks use of the record (CRITICAL_VALUE_MISSING). Material fields can never be declared tolerable. The tolerated list in the demonstration is illustrative.
effect_if_wrong: Too strict floods reviewers; too loose lets an unknown be treated as usable.

builder_reading: A secondary source that disagrees with the primary quarantines the primary. A secondary source that disagrees with itself holds the primary for a person. With no approved register nothing is authoritative.
effect_if_wrong: A different reading could let a disagreeing system pass or block more than intended.

builder_reading: Stable identifier, then a person-approved alias, then the exact full name with legal words kept, then resemblance, which only shows candidates and never chooses. SYN Metro Steel is not SYN Metro Steel Pty Ltd.
effect_if_wrong: A looser ladder risks a forced merge; a stricter one sends more to review.

builder_reading: A credit note is netted against its invoice only if the credit itself is trusted; otherwise the invoice is left out of the authoritative total. A reissue found by invoice-number pattern is lineage information only.
effect_if_wrong: Netting an untrusted credit would understate cost.

builder_reading: No built-in thresholds. A limit is configuration per use; with none configured the answer is cannot_assess, never fresh.
effect_if_wrong: A built-in limit would be an invented threshold.

builder_reading: Extracted values stay unverified until a person with the document_verifier role verifies them, tied to the document hash. Ambiguous readings offer candidates and are never chosen by software.
effect_if_wrong: A weaker rule would let an OCR guess drive a financial figure.

builder_reading: The reference runner uses three attempts and waits of 1, 2 and 4 seconds as configuration defaults. They are engineering defaults, not product decisions.
effect_if_wrong: Different bounds change load and delay, not correctness.

builder_reading: A delivery is identified by the file hash, the mapping version and the source name. The same bytes under another mapping version or from another source are a separate delivery.
effect_if_wrong: A different key would change what counts as a replay.

builder_reading: With no tolerance configured, amounts must be exactly equal (for example a retention receipt and its bank transaction). No tolerance value is chosen.
effect_if_wrong: A tolerance would let a near-miss count as evidence.

builder_reading: Forecast final cost is the actual cost up to the forecast date plus the cost to complete declared or derived at that date. Invoices dated after the forecast date are shown separately and are never added.
effect_if_wrong: Adding later actuals to a cost to complete that already expects them would count them twice.

builder_reading: Carrying cost is estimated from the as-of date to the expected release date on the funded share of the withheld balance. Cost already incurred is not estimated because no balance history is ingested. A release date that has passed with money still withheld gives cannot be assessed.
effect_if_wrong: A backward or flat estimate would state a cost that no evidence supports.

builder_reading: Secured revenue uses the variation register; when the contract summary disagrees, the figure is provisional and both numbers are listed. Submitted, disputed and rejected variations are never revenue.
effect_if_wrong: Using the summary instead would hide an approved variation, or count an unapproved one.

topic: Records that cannot be attributed to a project
builder_reading: A record whose project cannot be told appears as an unattributed exclusion on every project figure, so it cannot be missed. It is not added to any total.
effect_if_wrong: Dropping it would hide cost; adding it would count it on the wrong project.

topic: What a total of included records means
builder_reading: A cost, commitment or revenue total is the sum of the records that can be used. If any record is held, disputed or unknown the figure is provisional and lists it. Cannot be assessed is used only when no figure can be formed at all.
effect_if_wrong: Showing zero or hiding the total when one record is held would mislead in the other direction.

topic: M4 role names and separation of duties
builder_reading: The roles policy_owner, forecast_owner, retention_clerk and retention_approver are the builder's names, like I-2. Whoever proposes a policy cannot approve it; whoever runs a forecast cannot adopt it; approval, release and receipt of retention need the approver role and a human.
effect_if_wrong: Different names or weaker separation change who can make a figure authoritative or move retention between states.

builder_reading: Cost-to-cost is the only method implemented (recognised revenue is secured revenue times cost to date over forecast final cost). Selecting a method is a policy choice; with none selected there is no recognised margin.
effect_if_wrong: A different method (for example certified progress) gives a different recognised margin.

builder_reading: Every method, funded share and freshness limit in the demonstration policy is the builder's illustrative choice. The policy has no default for any open decision; an unset one gives cannot be assessed and names the decision.
effect_if_wrong: Treating the demonstration values as defaults would settle open decisions.

builder_reading: Three methods are offered as configuration: declared, budget less actual, and declared else budget less actual. A held declared line is never replaced by a budget figure. A budget already exceeded gives an unknown cost to complete, never a negative one.
effect_if_wrong: Falling back silently would hide a disputed estimate; a negative figure would understate cost.

builder_reading: Retention moves withheld, claimed, approved, released, received with a disputed side state, one evidenced event at a time. Released is not received; received needs a bank transaction of exactly that amount. A due date passing moves nothing and only raises a review flag.
effect_if_wrong: Promoting a state on a date would assert entitlement or cash that no one has evidenced.

builder_reading: The bridge splits the change in forecast margin into items that add up to it exactly. A newly counted record or a recorded reason explains an item; a method change, a changed amount or a blank reason does not. No materiality threshold is applied.
effect_if_wrong: A threshold would hide small unexplained movements; none is chosen.

builder_reading: Open commitment is the committed amount less what is invoiced, never below zero, with any overrun shown separately. Unapproved amendments are exposure, not commitment. Draft and cancelled orders are not commitments.
effect_if_wrong: Counting exposure as commitment would overstate the cost to come.
